chunk.text: I am in so much pain that I can't even breathe in the cold. My club is finished. In two days, Real Madrid lost two trophies. In three days, we lost two trophies. The coach was sacked. Questions are being asked on the board. Arbeloa is a coach who started just seven months ago. He doesn't really coach. He has no proper work. He is acting like a thug. We appointed him—what happened now? Should I judge him or not? We lost to a team that was in 17th position. Aren't you ashamed of yourselves? When Vinicius came onto the pitch, what was that performance? Are you serious? I saw you hitting free kicks before, what happened here?

You just scored two goals. You scored at the age of 18–19, and now this? Lamine Yamal is dominating at 18. He is playing like one of the best in the world. You should be ashamed. Aren't you embarrassed? Tell me something—we are grown-ups, beyond comparisons. But still, look at him. Yamal is 18 years old. Others are performing better than you. Yes, he scored a goal, but what did he do the entire game? Such a poor performance. I don’t even understand what was happening. He just stood there with no instructions. It was a very bad game, and they deserved to lose. The opponent hadn’t even won in their last 4–5 games.

They are near the bottom of the second division. Are you serious? Maybe I’m the crazy one for watching this. This project is going very badly, and results matter a lot. The board has already made decisions. We gave a coach six months. At least he had a vision. Arbeloa doesn’t. He just talks—'We are Real Madrid, we are Real Madrid.' Matches are not won like that. I don’t know what to say. Even if we win, I expected Madrid to turn things around, to move in the right direction and play proper football.

He has built a team of yes-men. Everyone just agrees. Since Arbeloa came, all he says is 'Vinicius is very good.' Repeating the same thing again and again. I don’t understand what’s happening. Of course, you have to protect players, I get that. You manage the atmosphere, support them, do macro and micro management. But where is the football? There is no system, no structure. It feels like motivation speeches instead of actual football.

Historically, this club has not always played better football than Barcelona. When we won the Champions League against Liverpool, did we play better? No. Against Dortmund, maybe yes, but they were also very good. I have rarely seen us dominate and win convincingly. After watching this club for 10–14 years, I am honestly tired. It’s simple—we don’t have the power to implement a proper system. We just want coaches who boost players' egos instead of building structure.

I am sorry, but this is the reality. Arbeloa has been appointed without a proper CV. There’s no strong reason for him to be here. He won’t get time for a project either. This is Real Madrid’s philosophy—constant ups and downs, constant changes. You bring in star players, change coaches again and again, and still expect stability. It’s chaotic unless you find a coach like Zidane or Ancelotti.

Will Arbeloa become that kind of coach? I don’t see it. He is 42 years old and recently retired. On what basis should I trust him? Did he achieve something extraordinary before? No. There is no strong evidence. His team performances don’t justify this level of trust.

Real Madrid B has average stats, not impressive. You can’t justify this appointment based on that. This was a bad game overall. I even missed part of it because I was exhausted. I thought at least in Copa del Rey we would perform better. But nothing changed. Even when academy players were used, there was no impact.

I couldn’t see anything in that game. The performance was unclear and directionless. We tried a 4-3 system, but I don’t even know what the plan was. There were attempts to attack, but nothing meaningful. Vinicius had a great previous game, but here everything fell apart.

Mbappé is not being utilized properly, or he is unavailable. Where is he? What is happening? This is a crucial knockout game, and you disappear? How is that acceptable? Losing in Copa del Rey is not unimportant. The club is already under pressure, and this makes it worse.

Why is Mbappé not playing? All the pressure falls on Vinicius. Yes, he was not great, but he cannot carry everything alone. Other players are replaceable, but not him. Meanwhile, others delivered more in certain moments. Still, the team lacks balance and clarity.

If I talk about something positive, the pressing system was visible. Arbeloa prefers high pressing. The front three tried pressing aggressively. But the backline is extremely immature and unstable. Defensively, we look completely disorganized.

There is no temperament, no calmness in defense. Players lose control easily. They need discipline and mental strength. It feels like frustration and anger are affecting performance. This is beyond just coaching—it’s a deeper issue.
There is no consistency. Players lose their temper constantly. At top clubs, this cannot happen. Discipline is essential. Right now, it feels like passion without control, which is harming the team.

Player form is dropping. Results are bad, so everything is being questioned. There is nothing positive right now except hoping for improvement in the next game. I expect actual football from the coach, not just emotions and reactions.

Passion alone is not enough. Even aggressive coaches like Mourinho had strong tactical systems. Here, I don’t see any clear footballing identity. Arbeloa was not even deeply involved in coaching before—this sudden jump is questionable.

This feels like a harsh reality. Hard work alone doesn’t always get rewarded. Even big institutions like Real Madrid operate similarly to corporate structures. Progress depends on internal dynamics as well.
I don’t know what to expect anymore—from defenders, forwards, or tactics. Let’s see what happens next. We’ll meet in the next video. Goodbye.
